official.deadline_note: No application opening or closing date is published on the programme page. Applicants register through the MOFA scholarship service form and the review and final approval process typically takes between 3 to 5 months, with updates and final admission results communicated by email or SMS.
official.status_note: The MOFA Scholarship Program page carries a live 'Apply Now' link to the scholarship service form and does not state a closing date for applications.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Does the program cover all tuition costs? Yes, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs covers all tuition costs in accordance with the program's policies.
benefits: Scholarship to study abroad for a Bachelor's degree at one of the world's top prestigious international universities approved by MOFA
Place in the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy's Post-Graduate Diploma in UAE Diplomacy and International Relations programme after the Bachelor's degree
Subsequent appointment to the diplomatic corps at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs after fulfilling graduation requirements
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs covers all tuition costs in accordance with the programme's policies
eligibility: Must be UAE nationals (holders of UAE passports and family book)
Must provide a certificate of Good Conduct and Behavior from the relevant official authorities in the UAE
Must be between 17 and 21 years old and have legal guardian approval; graduates from previous years may apply provided the applicant is between 17 and 22 years old at the time of application

Must have a high school diploma: General Stream and General Technical Stream 90% and above; American System and Other Systems 90% and above with a school transcript listing all related instructional subjects; Advanced Stream, Advanced Technical Stream and SABIS System 85% and above; Elite Stream and Advanced Science Program 80% and above

British System / IGCSE: completion of five IGCSE/GCSE subjects with a grade of B or higher and two AS/A Level subjects with a grade of C or higher, plus a school transcript listing all related instructional subjects
International Baccalaureate: completion of the IB Diploma with a minimum average of 30 points or higher, plus a school transcript listing all related science subjects
Must have an IELTS (Academic Module) score of 6.5 or above, or equivalent
Must hold an acceptance letter from an approved university listed and approved by MOFA
Must agree to study a third language, if required
Male applicants must provide a certificate of exemption or completion of national service
Must agree to join the UAE diplomatic corps at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a period equivalent to the number of academic years covered by the scholarship
Must agree to join Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy (AGDA) upon graduation
Must provide parental consent to join the scholarship programme
requirements: Register through the MOFA scholarship service form
Attach the required documents in PDF format upon registration
Hold an unconditional direct academic acceptance in a specific specialty, institution and country for the MOFA scholarship, indicating the programme start and end dates and the total cost
Pass the tests, interviews and additional conditions that form part of the admission procedure, including the mandatory interview
Completion or exemption from National Service is a requirement for applying
documents: Valid passport copy including the last page showing the unified number
Transcripts copy for grades Ten, Eleven and the first term of grade Twelve (first or last term if available), attested by relevant entities as applicable

Direct academic acceptance, unconditional to other requirements, in a specific specialty, institution and country for the MOFA scholarship, indicating the programme start and end dates and the total cost
Medical examination certificate, on the form available in the application and certified by any government hospital or medical center within the UAE
National service status certificate for male students
Certificate from a local bank under the student's name indicating the IBAN, after obtaining final approval (if the applicant is accepted)
Parental approval for students under 22 years of age (according to the Personal Affairs Law)
English language certificates with scores for one of the accepted tests
Certificate of Good Conduct and Behavior
selection_criteria: The admission procedure includes a number of tests, interviews and additional conditions
The interview is a mandatory part of the admission process and applicants must successfully pass it to complete the scholarship requirements
Applicants must secure admission from universities approved by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs only
coverage: All tuition costs, in accordance with the programme's policies
The page publishes no statement on living costs, accommodation, airfare or a stipend
application_method: Obtain an unconditional direct academic acceptance from a university on the MOFA-approved list for a specific specialty, institution and country, showing programme start and end dates and the total cost
Prepare the required documents in PDF format
Register through the MOFA scholarship service form at https://www.mofa.gov.ae/services/forms/scholarship
Upload the required documents with the registration
Complete the tests and interviews that form part of the admission procedure, including the mandatory interview
Track the application through programme notifications; updates including final admission results are communicated by email or SMS
If already submitted and an amendment is needed, call +971 80044444 so the existing application can be removed and a new, updated application submitted
official.application_route: Register through the MOFA scholarship service form and upload the documents in PDF; applications are tracked through programme notifications and amendments are handled via the +971 80044444 call centre.
official.study_mode: Full-time Bachelor's degree abroad at a MOFA-approved university
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be UAE nationals holding a UAE passport and family book.
official.international_eligibility: Not open to non-UAE nationals; the programme is for Emirati students.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Specialisation must be in a field that meets the needs of the UAE diplomatic corps, at a university on the MOFA-approved list of universities, countries and specializations.
official.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs provides a scholarship programme for outstanding Emirati students who wish to pursue their academic journey abroad at one of the world's top prestigious international universities, with the aim of specializing in fields that meet the needs of the UAE diplomatic corps and enriching it with qualified Emirati personnel. The MOFA covers all tuition costs in accordance with the programme's policies, and the student's journey runs from a Bachelor's abroad, through the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy, into the diplomatic corps.
official.english_requirement: IELTS (Academic Module) 6.5 or above, or equivalent. The FAQ states applicants must achieve a minimum score of 6.5 in Academic IELTS or an equivalent score in TOEFL.

not_confirmed: living cost, accommodation, airfare or stipend provision (not published)
verification.notes: The MOFA Scholarship Program page, its eligibility and conditions of acceptance section, its required documents list, the student's journey description and the full FAQ were read on mofa.gov.ae. The page confirms MOFA covers all tuition costs but publishes no monetary figure, no deadline and no statement on living costs or travel, so those fields remain null and are listed under not_confirmed.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a career pipeline into the UAE diplomatic corps, not a study-abroad grant: you must already hold an unconditional offer from a university on MOFA's own approved list, be willing to serve in the Ministry for as many years as the scholarship covers, and join the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy after graduation. There is no published deadline, so work backwards from your own timeline and expect the review and final approval process to take three to five months. The mandatory interview is the make-or-break stage, and an offer from a university not on the MOFA list cannot be used at all.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Emirati nationals aged 17-22 with a top-tier high school record, IELTS Academic 6.5 or equivalent, an unconditional offer from a MOFA-approved university, and a genuine commitment to a diplomatic career.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your target university and specialisation against MOFA's published list of universities, countries and specializations before applying anywhere
Secure an unconditional direct academic acceptance that states the programme start and end dates and the total cost, as the page requires all three
Book IELTS Academic early and aim above 6.5 rather than at the threshold
Get the medical examination certificate from a UAE government hospital or medical centre on the form supplied in the application
For male applicants, complete or obtain exemption from national service first
Have parental consent documented, since it is required for applicants under 22
common_rejection_risks: Holding an offer from a university outside the MOFA-approved list, which the FAQ rules out outright
A conditional or indirect acceptance rather than the unconditional direct academic acceptance required
Falling below the high school percentage threshold for your stream (90% General/General Technical and American, 85% Advanced/Advanced Technical/SABIS, 80% Elite and Advanced Science)
Missing the attestation requirements on transcripts or other documents
Underestimating the mandatory interview, which must be passed to complete the scholarship requirements
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The programme page publishes no figure for living costs, accommodation, airfare or a stipend, so assume you must fund your own living expenses abroad and confirm the exact scope with the programme officer before accepting.
document_audit: Every document must be attached in PDF format at registration, so scan and name them before you start the form
The bank certificate with the IBAN is only needed after final approval, so do not delay registration waiting for it
Transcripts for grades Ten, Eleven and the first term of grade Twelve must be attested by the relevant entities as applicable
If you have already submitted and need to change something, call +971 80044444 rather than filing a second application, because the existing one is removed before a new one can be submitted
alerts: Service obligation: you must join the MOFA diplomatic corps for a period equivalent to the number of academic years covered by the scholarship, and join AGDA on graduation
Male applicants must have completed or been exempted from national service
Changing major or country of study later requires informing the programme officer at the Ministry and notifying the cultural attache in the country of study
No deadline is published and the review takes 3-5 months, so start early and do not wait for a formal call
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure a MOFA-approved university offer, register via the MOFA scholarship service form with PDF documents, sit the tests and mandatory interview, then track status by email or SMS over a 3-5 month review.
